recentItems.description:

A new group of creators battles for a share of £1 million, but every comfort they take eats into the prize pot. Expect brutal decisions, unpredictable challenges and plenty of Sidemen mischief as the group fights to keep hold of the cash.

recentItems.title: UNABOMBER | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
Inspired by true events, UNABOMBER follows Ted Kaczynski’s (Jacob Tremblay) transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray (Russell Crowe), Kaczynski’s troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller (Shailene Woodley), brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

Moving between Kaczynski’s troubled past and the FBI investigation closing in on him, UNABOMBER reveals the chilling story behind the man, the mind, and the manhunt.

Starring Russell Crowe, Jacob Tremblay, Annabelle Wallis, and Shailene Woodley.
